details:
I suggest prominently placing an option in the game to guide users to set whether they are sensitive to VR motion sickness. Enable all available anti-motion sickness measures in the game by default. This can significantly increase the retention rate for VR users because, in my conversations with new users, many have no idea how to set up anti-motion sickness features, and some cannot smoothly play the game or wait for others to teach them, leading to game deletions.

Additionally, certain situations in the game, including bugs and being grabbed, may cause drastic shaking and trembling of the models, including UI jitter and distortion. This could induce severe dizziness in VR users, resulting in nausea or several hours of recovery time. I propose adding vibration and rotation to the viewpoint sphere, with rotation speed detection. For players who have activated advanced motion sickness protection, if exceptionally intense shaking beyond the threshold is detected, the viewpoint sphere will be forcefully stabilized, detached from the avatar to maintain relative stability, and a warning will pop up. Users can click to disable or adjust sensitivity.

After detecting the cessation of shaking, a countdown will begin, reminding users to close their eyes. The protection system is disengaging, and the viewpoint sphere moves back to the correct position relative to the avatar. After playing a notification sound, users are prompted to open their eyes.
title: Vertigo protection
